question: Which album earned Ricky Kej his third Grammy Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Divine Tides**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Divine Tides** is the album that earned **Ricky Kej **his **third Grammy Award**.
 
• This award was a significant achievement in Ricky Kej's music career, further establishing him as a renowned composer and environmentalist.
 
• The album is a collaboration between **Ricky Kej and Stewart Copeland**, the drummer of the legendary rock band **The Police**.
 
• Divine Tides features a wide range of musical styles and aims to deliver a message about the importance of nature conservation and environmental awareness.
 
• The recognition by the Grammy Awards highlights the global appreciation and impact of Ricky Kej's work in promoting sustainability through music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ricky Kej is an Indian composer and environmentalist known for his work in world music.
 
• He has received multiple awards and honors for his contributions to music and environmental advocacy.
 
• Ricky Kej's music often incorporates themes of **nature, sustainability, and global harmony**.
 
• In addition to his Grammy Awards, Ricky Kej has been recognized by various international organizations for his efforts in promoting environmental consciousness.
 
• His collaborations with other artists and musicians have further amplified his message and reach across different cultures and audiences.
